headline: UK Government Aims for 3% GDP Defense Spending Target by 2030
summary: The UK government aims to allocate 3% of economic output to defense by 2030, with plans to outline the target at next year's spending review while maintaining fiscal sustainability.
why: Fiscal policy and national defense allocations dictate government borrowing requirements and sovereign debt issuance, directly influencing UK gilt yields and defense sector procurement.

impacts.name: Defense
impacts.why: Higher government defense spending targets expand long-term procurement budgets for military contractors.
